declare
temp_unit varchar2(20);
begin
 :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 default_value('N','GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme');
 default_value('D','GLOBAL.checkin_type');
 default_value('N','GLOBAL.checked_bleed_time');
 default_value('111111111111111','GLOBAL.max_bleed_time');
 if :GLOBAL.checked_bleed_time = 'N'
 then
 -- this is to avoid database access repeatedly for
 -- same reason
 begin
 select max_bleed_time
 into :GLOBAL.max_bleed_time
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);

 end;

 check_package_failure;

 then

 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.field_left := 'ctrl_blk_1.unit_id';
 go_block('manual_unit_entry_COEXIST');
 else

 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_unit;
 :s_unit_id := :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id;
 NEXT_ITEM; 
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM'); 
 end if;

end;

declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 
 v_count number(10);
 
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select distinct contract_id, company
 into :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id, :s_contract_name
 from contracts c
 where c.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and exists (select *
 from units u
 where u.contract_id = c.contract_id
 and u.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and u.chapter_id = c.chapter_id)
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_contract_name := '';
 show_error('0120');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 --
 -- check that only internal units can be altered - TR# 1146
 -- 
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and contract_id = 'INTERNAL';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('9992');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;




 begin
 --
 -- Check for CUE. CUE check is checked for
 -- by the previous select also.
 --
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and donor_decision_code is not null
 and donor_decision_code != 'X';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0053');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 
/* diptiia - 3.1 -- SCR 310 - added code to prevent attributes to be added to units that have labeled components. Only unlabled components
 or those with a system label of NFT, quarantine, Discard or HOLD can be changed */ 

 select nvl(count(*), 0) into v_count 
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and upper(system_label_decision) not in ('47', '39', 'MD', 'MQ'); 

 if v_count > 0 then
 show_error('0185');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 null;
 end if; 

exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;

 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: QC_LABEL_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure qc_label_check(qc_flag OUT VARCHAR2, label_flag OUT VARCHAR2) is
 tmp_qc_label_flag VARCHAR2(1);
begin
 begin
 select qc_label_flag
 into tmp_qc_label_flag
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 tmp_qc_label_flag := 'N';
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 and qc_checkin_flag = 'Y'
 and qc_checkin_date is not null
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id;
 qc_flag := 'Y';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 qc_flag := 'N';
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 and component_status = 'L'
 --and system_label_decision not in ('39','71') --HCLC Code128
 and system_label_decision not in 
 (SELECT abo_label --HCLC Code128
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE identifier_code = 'EM' 
 AND unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365))
 and system_label_decision != 'Mq' 
 and (system_label_decision in ('Md', 'Mx') /*= '47'*/ and --HCLC Code128
 reject_reason_code is null)
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id;
 label_flag := 'Y';
 exception
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 label_flag := 'Y';
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 label_flag := 'N';
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;
